findings.highlight: it happened because you came in the middle of the night and stomped on my hand while I was sleeping
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が寝てる間に桜が踏んづけて出来た痣だとか
findings.governingReading: He teasingly asks whether the bruise came from Sakura stepping on him during his sleep.
findings.explanation: Shirou's joke that Sakura may have stepped on his hand while he slept adds a middle-of-the-night visit.

findings.highlight: I just hope it's just my mistake
findings.evidenceJa: 間違いだったら、いいって
findings.governingReading: She says only that it would be good if this were a mistake, leaving both the referent and whose error it might be unstated.
findings.explanation: Sakura hoping that an unspecified concern is mistaken becomes hoping it is specifically her mistake.

findings.highlight: Sakura may be quiet, but she generally speaks her mind.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は無口だけど、言うべき事ははっきりと言う子だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that despite being quiet, she normally states what must be said plainly, making this evasiveness unusual.
findings.explanation: Sakura clearly saying necessary things becomes generally speaking her mind.
